corrections.text: The article quotes CyberPress as saying the restructuring in version 1.26.2 made it "harder" to detect. The word "harder" does not appear anywhere in the cited CyberPress article (or in any of the other four cited sources). CyberPress's actual wording is: "Version 1.26.2 restored the legitimate package initializer and moved execution to af_runtime_diag.pth and af_runtime_diag.py, so inspecting the initializer alone would miss the second variant." The underlying claim is accurate; the quotation marks around "harder" are not.

The article quotes Endor Labs as saying "LiteLLM 1.107.0 employed identical techniques last month." Endor Labs' actual wording is: "LiteLLM 1.107.0 used the same technique last month." The paraphrase preserves the meaning but is not a verbatim quotation.
